report_name: McKesson Discloses Breach After ShinyHunters Claims Patient Data Theft

threat_actors.name: ShinyHunters
threat_actors.description: A financially motivated extortion group that claimed responsibility for the McKesson data breach, alleging the exfiltration of approximately 1 terabyte of data, including 284 million patient-related records, from a Snowflake cloud environment.
threat_actors.goals: Data theft for extortion and selling stolen data on dark web forums.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: Assessed as a likely initial access vector for the McKesson breach, potentially through a vulnerability in a third-party application.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: Considered a high-probability initial access method, where attackers likely used compromised credentials to access the Snowflake cloud environment or a connected application.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Cloud Storage
attack_patterns.description: The core of the attack involved accessing and staging data within McKesson's Snowflake cloud data warehouse for exfiltration.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration to Cloud Storage
attack_patterns.description: Assessed as a potential exfiltration method where ShinyHunters moved the stolen data from McKesson's Snowflake environment to their own cloud storage.

identities.name: McKesson
identities.description: A U.S. healthcare and pharmaceutical distributor that suffered a data breach where approximately 1 terabyte of data was exfiltrated from its Snowflake cloud environment by the ShinyHunters group.

indicators.name: Anomalous Snowflake Login from New Geolocation
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Snowflake Login from New Geolocation
id: 4f5b9e1a-8c7d-4f6a-b3e2-1a9c8d7e6f5b
status: experimental
description: Detects login activity to a Snowflake environment from an unfamiliar geolocation, which could indicate compromised credentials as seen in the McKesson breach.
references:
  - https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/mckesson-discloses-breach-after-shinyhunters-claims-patient-data-theft/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-29
tags:
  - attack.t1078
  - attack.initial_access
level: medium
logsource:
  product: snowflake
  category: authentication
detection:
  selection:
    event_type: 'LOGIN'
    success: true
  filter:
    country|startswith:
      - 'US'
  condition: selection and not filter
indicators.description: Detects login activity to a Snowflake environment from an unfamiliar geolocation, which could indicate compromised credentials.

indicators.name: Potential Data Exfiltration via Snowflake COPY Command
indicators.pattern:
title: Potential Data Exfiltration via Snowflake COPY Command
id: 9a8b7c6d-5e4f-4a3b-2c1d-0e9f8a7b6c5d
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of the 'COPY INTO @...' command in Snowflake, which can be used to unload large amounts of data to an external stage for exfiltration, a technique relevant to the McKesson breach.
references:
  - https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/mckesson-discloses-breach-after-shinyhunters-claims-patient-data-theft/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-29
tags:
  - attack.t1530
  - attack.t1567.002
  - attack.collection
  - attack.exfiltration
level: high
logsource:
  product: snowflake
  category: database
detection:
  selection:
    query_text|startswith: 'COPY INTO @'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of the 'COPY INTO @...' command in Snowflake, which can be used to unload large amounts of data to an external stage for exfiltration.

indicators.name: Potential Data Exfiltration Path Creation in Snowflake
indicators.pattern:
title: Potential Data Exfiltration Path Creation in Snowflake
id: e1f2a3b4-c5d6-4e7f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of a new external stage in Snowflake. Attackers may create external stages pointing to their own cloud storage to exfiltrate data, a relevant TTP for data theft from cloud warehouses.
references:
  - https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/mckesson-discloses-breach-after-shinyhunters-claims-patient-data-theft/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-29
tags:
  - attack.t1567.002
  - attack.exfiltration
level: medium
logsource:
  product: snowflake
  category: database
detection:
  selection:
    query_text|startswith:
      - 'CREATE STAGE'
      - 'CREATE OR REPLACE STAGE'
  filter:
    query_text|contains:
      - 'url = ''s3://my-legit-bucket/'
  condition: selection and not filter
indicators.description: Detects the creation of a new external stage in Snowflake, which can be used as a pathway for data exfiltration.

indicators.name: Suspicious Execution of Snowflake CLI
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Execution of Snowflake CLI
id: 6d5e4f3a-2b1c-4d9e-8f7a-6b5c4d3e2f1a
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of the Snowflake command-line tool 'snowsql' from a non-standard location or unauthorized system, which could indicate hands-on-keyboard activity against a Snowflake environment.
references:
  - https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/mckesson-discloses-breach-after-shinyhunters-claims-patient-data-theft/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-29
tags:
  - attack.t1059
  - attack.execution
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\snowsql.exe'
  filter:
    Image|startswith:
      - 'C:\Program Files\Snowflake SnowSQL\'
  condition: selection and not filter
indicators.description: Detects the execution of the Snowflake command-line tool 'snowsql' from unauthorized systems.
